mount_point.description: Mount point for the LXCFS FUSE filesystem. Must exist and be accessible by the lxcfs process.

pid_user.description: User account under which LXCFS will run.

pid_group.description: Group under which LXCFS will run.

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file for the LXCFS daemon.

num_threads.description: Number of I/O worker threads. Set to 0 for single-threaded operation.

libvirt_support.description: Enable support for libvirt-managed containers (requires libvirt integration).

cgroupv2.description: Enable cgroup v2 support (required on systems using systemd with unified cgroup hierarchy).

bind_mounts.description: List of additional host paths to bind-mount into the container namespace.

source.description: Absolute path on the host to mount.

target.description: Path inside LXCFS mount point where source will appear.

pam_service.description: Optional custom PAM service name. Leave empty to use default 'lxcfs'.

follow_symlinks.description: Whether to follow symlinks under /proc (security risk if enabled).

namespace_support.description: Enable support for namespace-aware UID/GID remapping in privileged containers.
